proof_body:
by
  intro 𝕜 _ E F _ _ _ _ T x M hT hx
  have hc := hT.isCompact_closure_image_closedBall (f := (T : E →ₗ[𝕜] F)) M
  have hmem : ∀ n, T (x n) ∈ closure (T '' Metric.closedBall 0 M) := fun n =>
    subset_closure ⟨x n, by simpa using hx n, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨y, _, φ, hφ, ht⟩ := hc.tendsto_subseq hmem
  exact ⟨y, φ, hφ, ht⟩
target_source: ∀ (𝕜 : Type*) [RCLike 𝕜] (E F : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace 𝕜 F] (T : E →L[𝕜] F) (x : ℕ → E) (M : ℝ), IsCompactOperator T → (∀ n, ‖x n‖ ≤ M) → ∃ (y : F) (φ : ℕ → ℕ), StrictMono φ ∧ Filter.Tendsto (fun n => T (x (φ n))) Filter.atTop (nhds y)
